description: Turn the library's domain protection on or off (block_none_refer). false = protection OFF for the whole library: every request plays, with or without a referer, and even BLOCK domains are ignored. true = the ACTIVE domains apply: requests without a referer are blocked (native TV/iOS players excepted), with ALLOW domains only matching referers play, with only BLOCK domains the matching referers are blocked; with no active domain nothing is blocked. WARNING: this also rewrites the status of ALL the library's domains (library and folders): true activates every domain, including ones turned off on purpose (to keep one off, deactivate it afterwards with panda_set_refer_status); false deactivates all of them. Refused (400) while any domain is still pending, deleting or turning inactive. The server recalculates the flag afterwards: it is true while at least one domain is active. On error the API returns { errCode, errMsg }. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted.

block_none_refer.description: true = protection on (active domains apply; all domains are activated); false = protection off (all domains are deactivated)

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

name: panda_set_block_none_refer
title: Turn Domain Protection On/Off
